idea-plugin.name: DeepSeek Harness Bridge
idea-plugin.description:
English

One job only: send the code you selected in IntelliJ IDEA to the DeepSeek Harness window you already have open, in the fixed reference format @/path/File.kt#L10-20. The same shortcut also sends the file or folder you selected in the Project view (@/path/to/File.kt / @/path/to/folder) — no editor needed.

The plugin does not start, embed, or manage any DSH process — no Node.js path, no provider API keys, no embedded browser. It writes one small JSON file into ~/.dsh/idea-bridge/inbox, and the companion DeepSeek Harness plugin dsh-idea-bridge puts that reference into the composer of the session bound to your project (and submits it, if you want).

How to use

  1. Install the companion dsh-idea-bridge plugin into your DeepSeek Harness profile (see dsh-idea-bridge/README.md) and restart DeepSeek Harness.
  2. Open your project in DeepSeek Harness (desktop client or the web UI) — the session whose working directory is that project receives the references.
  3. In IDEA, select code and press Ctrl+Alt+K (or right-click → Send Selection to DSH). No selection sends a whole-file reference.
  4. To reference a whole file or a folder, right-click it in the Project view → Send File/Folder Path to DSH, or focus the Project view and press Ctrl+Alt+K. Multiple selected files/folders are sent as one reference each.

Behaviour

  • Pre-fills the DeepSeek Harness input box and leaves it there — you add your question and press Enter. Turn on Submit the message automatically in Settings → Tools → DeepSeek Harness Bridge if you want it sent immediately.
  • File/folder paths are sent without line numbers; directories become plain @/path/to/folder text (never a clickable file chip).
  • If anything goes wrong, the reference is copied to the clipboard so nothing is lost.
  • Bilingual UI (English / 简体中文).

中文

只做一件事：把你在 IntelliJ IDEA 中选中的代码，以固定引用格式 @/path/File.kt#L10-20 发送到你已经打开着的 DeepSeek Harness 窗口。 同一个快捷键也支持把项目树里选中的文件或文件夹按 @/path/to/File.kt / @/path/to/folder 发出去——不需要打开编辑器。

插件不再启动、内嵌或管理任何 DSH 进程——不需要 Node.js 路径、不需要服务商 API Key、 也不再内嵌浏览器。它只往 ~/.dsh/idea-bridge/inbox 写一个很小的 JSON 文件， 由配套的 DSH 插件 dsh-idea-bridge 把这条引用写进"当前项目对应会话"的输入框 （按你的设置决定是否直接提交）。

使用方法

  1. 先在你的 DeepSeek Harness profile 里安装配套插件 dsh-idea-bridge （见 dsh-idea-bridge/README.md）并重启 DeepSeek Harness。
  2. 在 DeepSeek Harness（桌面客户端或网页）里打开同一个项目——工作目录与该项目的 会话会接收引用。
  3. 在 IDEA 中选中代码，按 Ctrl+Alt+K（或右键 → 发送选中代码到 DSH）。 没有选区时发送整文件引用。
  4. 要发送整个文件或文件夹：在项目树里右键 → 发送文件/文件夹路径到 DSH， 或让项目树获得焦点后按 Ctrl+Alt+K。多选时每个文件/文件夹各发一条引用。

行为说明

  • 默认只把引用填进 DeepSeek Harness 输入框，你自己补一句话再回车；需要立即发送就在 设置 → Tools → DeepSeek Harness Bridge 勾上"自动提交"。
  • 文件/文件夹路径引用不带行号；目录只发纯文本 @/path/to/folder ， 不会生成可点击的文件 chip。
  • 任何环节失败都会把引用复制到剪贴板，保证内容不丢。
  • 中英双语界面。
idea-plugin.change-notes:
English / 中文

v2.1.3

  • Fix: Ctrl+Alt+K in the editor sent a whole-file reference and dropped the line numbers. The action no longer uses LangDataKeys.IDE_VIEW to detect the Project view: the platform also supplies an editor-backed IdeView in the editor data context, so 2.1.2 always took the "Project view" branch (lineStart = 0). Editor mode is now decided by the presence of CommonDataKeys.EDITOR alone. 修复：在编辑器里按 Ctrl+Alt+K 只发整文件路径、丢失行号。2.1.2 用 LangDataKeys.IDE_VIEW 判断“项目树模式”，而平台在编辑器上下文里也会提供 一个编辑器版 IdeView，于是永远走了项目树分支（行号为 0）。现在只用 CommonDataKeys.EDITOR 是否存在来区分两种模式。
  • Every send now logs its exact reference text (including #L…) to idea.log, so the delivered format is verifiable without inspecting the inbox. 每次投递都会把实际引用文本（含 #L…）写进 idea.log， 排查时不用再去翻收件箱。

v2.1.2

  • No upper build limit: until-build is omitted, so the plugin is no longer rejected as incompatible after an IntelliJ IDEA update. 移除 build 上限：不再设置 until-build，IDEA 更新大版本后不会再提示插件不兼容。

v2.1.1

  • Compatibility with IntelliJ IDEA 2026.3 (build 263): the supported build range is now 241 – 263.*. 兼容 IntelliJ IDEA 2026.3（build 263）：支持范围扩展到 241 – 263.*。

v2.1.0

  • Send file and folder paths from the Project view: right-click a file/folder → Send File/Folder Path to DSH, or focus the Project view and press the same Ctrl+Alt+K. Multiple selection sends one reference per item; folders are sent as plain @/path/to/folder text instead of a file chip. 支持从项目树发送文件/文件夹路径：右键 → 发送文件/文件夹路径到 DSH，或让项目树 获得焦点后按同一个 Ctrl+Alt+K。多选时每个条目各发一条；文件夹只发 @/path/to/folder 纯文本，不生成文件 chip。
  • Message files gain an optional kind field (file | directory); older readers ignore it (contract v1.2, still backward compatible). 消息文件新增可选字段 kind（file | directory）， 旧版本读取方会忽略（契约 v1.2，向后兼容）。

v2.0.0

  • Pivot to a single feature: send the editor selection to the DeepSeek Harness instance you already have open. The embedded web UI, the DSH process lifecycle, the IDE MCP endpoint, review/snapshot tooling, provider settings and credential sync are all removed (~7000 lines → ~600). 战略收敛为单一功能：把选中代码发送到你已经打开的 DeepSeek Harness。内嵌 Web UI、 DSH 进程管理、IDE MCP 端点、评审/快照、服务商配置与凭据同步全部删除（约 7000 行 → 约 600 行）。
  • Plugin renamed to DeepSeek Harness Bridge; the repository is now dsh-idea-bridge with the IntelliJ plugin in idea-plugin/ and the companion DSH plugin in dsh-plugin/. The plugin ID, the inbox directory and the /idea-bridge/* routes are unchanged. 插件更名为 DeepSeek Harness Bridge；仓库更名为 dsh-idea-bridge， IDEA 插件在 idea-plugin/，DSH 侧插件在 dsh-plugin/； 插件 ID、收件箱目录与 /idea-bridge/* 路由均不变。

v1.1.0

  • Draft by default: the reference is placed in the DeepSeek Harness input box and left there — you add your question and press Enter. Auto-submit is now an opt-in setting. 默认只填输入框（草稿），你自己补话再回车；自动提交改为需要手动开启。
  • Strict project routing: a reference is delivered only to the session whose working directory equals the project root, and when there is none the plugin now says so (with a clipboard fallback) instead of pretending it was sent. 严格项目路由：只投给工作目录等于项目根的会话；没有这样的会话时会明确提示（并回退剪贴板），不再"假成功"。

v1.0.0

  • Initial release: embedded DeepSeek Harness web UI, send selection to DSH, review changes with diff, bilingual UI (English / 简体中文).

action.description: Send the current editor selection, or the files/folders selected in the Project view, to the DeepSeek Harness window you already have open
